sentence_heads: ISQL Core treats code space before application.
A stable address identifies the source, while memory representations may change independently.
R1 keeps a compact semantic skeleton and keywords.
R2 retains a structured set of sentence heads.
R3 preserves a rich normalized reconstruction with metadata.
R4 links back to the exact UTF-8 source when exact recovery is required.
The decoder is an explicit parameter: software can decode deterministically, while a stronger AI decoder may reconstruct additional semantic detail from lower-resolution codes and context.
Exact recovery and semantic recovery remain different contracts.
中文、英文與其他語言都可以成為不同 realization，但不應改變底層 identity。這個實驗的目的不是宣稱壓縮率已經最佳，而是先確認 Address、Memory、Resolution、Decoder、Recoverability 可以在同一個可測框架中運作。
